pages.title: Relics of the Fallen
pages.text: $(bold)The arms and keepsakes Vaskar's Remains leaves on the dead you find in the world: elven, orcish, knightly and royal weapons, mage rods and staves, crowns and trinkets. The bodies and graves themselves can always be searched.$(br2)$(thing)Hearth$(n), ring 4.$(br)$(thing)10 Focal Shards$(n).$(br)After Scout.
